podcast.title: Paul Yego's Musical Project
podcast.body: Said Dog is a musical project formed by Paul Yego, former singer of The Gufs, and his wife. This endeavor showcases his continued involvement in music, separate from his previous band. "He also has a musical project with his wife called Said Dog, and you can find them on Facebook."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Lost CanRock Bands of the '90s: Part 1

xref.title: Paul Yego's Post-Band Career
xref.body: Singer Paul Yego is now a geologist residing in Nothing, Arizona, a town located in the northwest part of the state. He also maintains a musical project called Said Dog with his wife. "singer Paul Yego is now a geologist. He's living in Arizona. He was headquartered in a place, and I'm deadly serious about this, a place called Nothing Arizona."
